title: PowerGrid: Core Loop
summary: Generate, buffer, distribute, meter, and isolate power before adding new load.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Generate power, buffer it, distribute it through appropriate cables, monitor demand, isolate overloads, and upgrade the weakest segment before adding new load.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each expansion, read the meters and breakers. If demand spikes or voltage sags, strengthen that segment before plugging in another machine.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop when storage, breakers, and labels all match the current load. A quiet grid is easier to expand than a mystery cable bundle.

blocks.title: Loop Anchor
blocks.body: Treat this as a material checkpoint: if it helps the loop, bring it home before chasing bulk.
blocks.label: Redstone
blocks.subtitle: Core Loop checkpoint
